_about: Hand changes applied on top of out/*.json by tools/convert_routes.py, per guide, in order. 'replace_qid' {from, to} fixes a wrong quest ID on every step of that quest in the guide. Other entries find one step by 'step' {action, qid}: 'after' {action, qid} moves it right after that step, 'note' replaces its note, 'optional': true marks it skippable. 'why' is for people reading this file.

Durotar (1-12).note: Gornek, right after Your Place In The World
Mai'ah, at the Den entrance. Read the Glyphic Parchment first
Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons around the valley while killing boars and heading to Sarkoth

Stranglethorn Vale (47).why: #614 is the Alliance-only version (level 51); the Booty Bay one for Horde is #8551 from Captain Hecklebury Smotts (level 47)

Elwynn Forest (1-12).why: #1717 is the level 20 Gakin's Summons; the level 10 one from Remen Marcot is #1685

Westfall (11-17).why: same quest as the Elwynn accept
Voidwalker Binding (Bloodstone Choker, Gakin, level 10) is #1689; #1795 is the level 30 Felhunter one

Hillsbrad Foothills (31-32).why: #4736 is the Horde version (Briarthorn); Zevrost in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern gives #4737

Hillsbrad Foothills (31-32).note: Downstairs in Stormwind Cathedral. Needs level 34: skip it if you can't take it yet
